original_tile.description: Marsh reed was handcrossed by warp and weft into a vessel for sheaf and other dry goods.

source_features: Low rounded woven vessel beneath a tall arching carry loop. Bottom warp/weft marks establish woven reed material. Small internal glyph marks do not identify actual inventory contents.

source_behavior.scope: Native dry-goods inventory/open behavior, furniture tags and organic damage remain native. Empty/full tile is identical; no new lid or contents state.

palette.primary: w metadata foreground, unused by visible source ink
palette.rule: Keep neutral reed shading and one coverage; all visible shape uses detail ownership, as in the original mask.

donor_reference.role: Actual installed woven storage basket supplies reed-crossing/shadow/edge convention. Keep the source rounded bowl and tall single arch; do not import rectangular donor footprint, capacity, stored goods or game behavior.

authored_interpretation: A complete hollow close-woven bowl with bound rim, one tall carry loop and visible warp/weft courses. Hidden depth, thickness, strand count and weave geometry are authored; no contents inferred.

view_contract.south: Source map-facing tall arch left/right over open low bowl; two loop ends continue into bound rim/wall.
view_contract.east: Actual same object profile, adequate bowl depth, physically edge-on loop; no independent panel compression.
view_contract.north: Actual same object back, same complete arch/rim and continuous weave.
view_contract.production: One original fixed map tile only. East/north are retained authoring views, not new native direction states.
view_contract.scale: 16x24 native source ->512x768 manual ->256square recipient, anchor8,16; one physical frame for all exports.
